effects.effect: You can sense the presence of creatures with the Elemental or Dragon keywords within 1 mile of you. You can innately feel their emotions or pain, and you can't obtain lower than a tier 2 outcome on any [Intuition](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/intuition) [test](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test) made to socially interact with them.
